fullPassage: Robert Blattberg and Steven Hoch noted that, in a changing environment, it is not clear that consistency is always a virtue and that one of the advantages of human judgment is the ability to detect change. Thus, in changing environments, it might be advantageous to combine human judgment and statistical models. Blattberg and Hoch examined this possibility by having supermarket managers forecast demand for certain products and then creating a composite forecast by averaging these judgments with the forecasts of statistical models based on past data. The logic was that statistical models deny stable conditions and therefore cannot account for the effects on demand of novel events such as actions taken by competitors or the introduction of new products. Humans, however, can incorporate these novel factors in their judgments. The composite — or average of human judgments and statistical models — proved to be more accurate than either the statistical models or the managers working alone.

questions.passage: Robert Blattberg and Steven Hoch noted that, in a changing environment, it is not clear that consistency is always a virtue and that one of the advantages of human judgment is __________. Thus, in changing environments, it might be advantageous to combine human judgment and statistical models. Blattberg and Hoch examined this possibility by having supermarket managers forecast demand for certain products and then creating a composite forecast by averaging these judgments with the forecasts of statistical models based on past data. The logic was that statistical models deny stable conditions and therefore cannot account for the effects on demand of novel events such as actions taken by competitors or the introduction of new products. Humans, however, can incorporate these novel factors in their judgments. The composite — or average of human judgments and statistical models — proved to be more accurate than either the statistical models or the managers working alone.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① the limitation of past data: 과거 데이터의 한계는 통계 모델의 약점이지 인간 판단의 장점이 아님
✅ ② the ability to detect change: 원문 일치. '인간 판단의 장점은 변화를 감지하는 능력' ←정답
❌ ③ the accuracy of statistical models: 통계 모델의 정확성은 인간 판단의 장점이 아님
❌ ④ the consistency of human judgment: 일관성은 미덕이 아닐 수 있다고 했으므로 부적절
det.tip: one of the advantages of human judgment is the ability to detect change

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① competitive: 경쟁적인. 통계 모델이 가정하는 조건의 성격이 아님
❌ ② flexible: 유연한. 오히려 통계 모델의 한계인 변화 대응 불가와 모순
❌ ③ unpredictable: 예측 불가능한. 통계 모델이 가정하는 조건이 예측 불가라면 모델 자체가 성립 안 됨
✅ ④ stable: 원문 일치. '안정적인(stable) 조건을 가정'하므로 새로운 사건 대응 불가 ←정답
det.tip: statistical models assume stable conditions
